# Erick Vásquez Murillo

> Backend Engineer from Costa Rica (Java, Spring Boot, Vert.x, Node.js, TypeScript), applied-research enthusiast (geospatial data, applied AI). Works at Yaipan building microservices and enterprise backend systems for financial and ERP environments.

## About

- [About](https://www.erickvasm.com/es#about): Bio, background and core stack.
- [Experience](https://www.erickvasm.com/es#experiences): Backend Engineer at Yaipan; volunteer technical lead at Awaq NGO.

## Research

- [Classification of districts in Costa Rica using geospatial data](https://www.erickvasm.com/papers/geospatial-classification): PCA and k-means clustering of Costa Rica's districts, presented at JOCLAD 2025 / XXXII Meeting of CLAD, Porto.
- [UCR Guanacaste Beamer template](https://www.overleaf.com/latex/templates/universidad-de-costa-rica-sede-guanacaste-carrera-informatica-empresarial-beamer/mnpbpyzshxfd): Beamer presentation template for Universidad de Costa Rica's Informática Empresarial students and professors.
- [UCR Guanacaste assignment template](https://www.overleaf.com/latex/templates/universidad-de-costa-rica-sede-guanacaste-carrera-informatica-empresarial/jnvmbhphcqnq): LaTeX template for assignments and research papers, co-authored with Luis Edo. Amaya-Briceño.

## Portfolio

- [Portfolio](https://www.erickvasm.com/es#portfolio): Zona Descarga, Gym API, Municipalidad de Carrillo virtual assistant (chatbot).
